notablePrerequisites: You control a Treasure token.
description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling the top card of your library and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite card draw for all players
Infinite draw triggers for all players

notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
The total mana value of the creature on the battlefield and the creature card in your graveyard is at most 6.
notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
notes: If the combined mana value of the creatures is less than 6, this combo will net infinite energy counters.

notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander, and your commander is a Pirate.
You control at least one additional creature or artifact.
description:
Activate your commander by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite card draw for any number of players
Infinite draw triggers for any number of players

notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Xorn
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror and putting it onto the battlefield as a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability twice by tapping Magda and another Dwarf you control with power two or greater.
Magda triggers twice, creating six Treasure, six Food and six Clue artifact tokens.
 Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Maskwood Nexus and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability twice by tapping Academy Manufactor and Cursed Mirror.
Magda triggers twice, creating six Treasure, six Food and six Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel and putting it onto the battlefield as a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Sculpting Steel.
Magda triggers, creating nine Treasure, nine Food and nine Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Xorn and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Xorn.
Magda triggers, creating eighteen Treasure, eighteen Food and eighteen Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Dwarven Scorcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Dwarven Scorcher.
Magda triggers, creating eighteen Treasure, eighteen Food and eighteen Clue artifact tokens.

Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Elixir of Immortality by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to gain five life and shuffle your graveyard into your library.
Repeat from step 16.

Burakos triggers, creating five Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose four life.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate the five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.

description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to an indestructible creature an opponent controls.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Mary Read and Anne Bonny by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and discard Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Skyswimmer Koi triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to draw a card.
Holding priority, activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.

Repeat from step 2.
notes: You may resolve the other Skyswimmer Koi trigger, choosing to loot and get tapped Treasure tokens from Mary Read and Anne Bonny.

notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Ganax.
description:
Activate Ganax by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ganax.
Resolve the Ganax, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

Infinite untap of creatures you control

description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Jan Jansen by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, creating three Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Jan Jansen by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Activate Jan Jansen by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
notes: Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you can use Jan Jansen's second ability, paired with untapping it, infinitely to get infinite Construct tokens.

Infinite card draw for any number of opponents

Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

feature.name: Destroy each creature that enters the battlefield under an opponent's control

notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

Repeat.

You have {3}{U}{R} plus one mana of any color available if Ashling's Command is in your hand.
You have {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus one mana of any color available if Ashling's Command is in your graveyard.
description:
If Ashling's Command is in your hand, cast it by paying {3}{U}{R}. If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Xorn, and then creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding four mana of four different colors.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Xorn, and then creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to two plus the number of Xorns you control.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 4.
notes: You will progressively make more Xorns with each iteration and thus more Treasures. Once you have at least three total Xorns, you can forego making more if desired to choose other modes.

description:

Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating a Food token, a Clue token, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clue token and the Food token to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist with haste.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Twinflame to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

Repeat.

When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating two copies of any noncreature nonartifact permanent that are 3/3 Dragons.
When the Dragons enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Ganax each trigger twice.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Astral Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating six Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland permanent.
description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

description:
Cast Unexpected Windfall by paying {2}{R}{R} and discarding a card.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Unexpected Windfall.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the copy of Unexpected Windfall, creating three Treasure artifact tokens and causing you to draw two cards.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.

Skullport Merchant enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding two mana of any color.
Repeat.

Ziatora triggers, holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ziatora's ability.
Resolve the copy of Ziatora's ability, dealing damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target and creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ziatora's ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.

When the Anarchist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Twinflame to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.

Prosper triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

Najeela and Burakos triggers.

Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.

The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.
